scoring_justification: Full recompute of second finite differences of total energy and density coefficient from raw XYZ structures; peaks/minima matched against paper-reported magic numbers and close-packed sizes.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold magic numbers and close-packed sizes for comparison
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper conclusions: magic numbers 7,13,19,23,26,29,34,37,40,43; close-packed sizes 4,6,13,23,26,29,34
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values, not invented.

schema.format_description: Extended XYZ file: each frame starts with atom count N, then a comment line 'energy=<value_in_eV>', then N lines each with atom type 'Au' and x,y,z coordinates in angstroms. The file contains 43 frames in order for n=2 to 44.

outputs.description: Raw optimized structures and total energies used by the checker to recompute energetic and structural stability functions (second finite differences) and identify magic numbers and close-packed sizes.

output_contract.notes: The checker will parse this file, extract per-cluster total energy and atomic coordinates, compute the second finite difference of total energy Δ₂E(n) and identify peaks (magic numbers), compute cluster radii r_n, density coefficients σ(n)=n/r_n³, their second finite differences, and identify minima (close-packed sizes). Results will be compared to paper-reported magic numbers [7,13,19,23,26,29,34,37,40,43] and close-packed sizes [4,6,13,23,26,29,34] within ±1 tolerance.

steps.description: Recompute energetic and structural stability from raw XYZ; identify magic numbers and close-packed sizes, plus radius trend.
